cognates.Avatar: Croatian has adopted 'avatar' unchanged for a profile picture; core hr uses it too, so translating it would invent a term users do not know.
cognates.CSV: File-format initialism, identical in Croatian; every other finished locale keeps it as-is.
cognates.Deck: Proper name of the Nextcloud Deck app; product names are not translated.
cognates.DSAR: Initialism for Data Subject Access Request. Croatian GDPR practice has coined no equivalent acronym, and the expanded key 'Data-subject access request' is translated in full alongside it.
cognates.Excel (.xlsx): Product name plus a file extension; both are invariant in Croatian.
cognates.Format: Croatian uses 'format' unchanged for a data/display format; core hr has no competing term.
cognates.ID: Initialism written identically in Croatian; the lowercase variant key 'Id' is normalised TO this form rather than left alone.
cognates.ID:: Same initialism with a colon. Croatian, unlike French, puts no space before a colon, so the punctuation is genuinely unchanged.
cognates.ID: {id}: Same initialism plus the placeholder; nothing in this string differs in Croatian.
cognates.Interval: Croatian 'interval' is the standard term and is spelled identically.
cognates.Minimum: Croatian 'minimum' is the standard term and is spelled identically; the derived 'Minimum length/value' keys are translated as 'Minimalna …'.
cognates.OpenDocument (.ods): Product name plus a file extension; both are invariant in Croatian.
cognates.PDF: File-format initialism, identical in Croatian; every other finished locale keeps it as-is.
cognates.RBAC: Initialism for role-based access control, used untranslated in Croatian IT writing; the expanded prose keys around it are translated in full.
cognates.Slug: Croatian technical writing keeps the English 'slug' for a URL-friendly identifier; no Croatian equivalent is in use, and the descriptive key 'Optional URL-friendly identifier' is translated in full beside it.
cognates.Status: Croatian 'status' is the standard term and is spelled identically; core hr confirms it.
cognates.URL: Initialism written identically in Croatian; the lowercase-variant key 'Url' is normalised TO this form, and 'Database URL' etc. are translated as 'URL baze podataka'.
cognates.UUID:: Initialism with a colon. Croatian, unlike French, puts no space before a colon, so the punctuation is genuinely unchanged.
cognates.Webhook: Croatian keeps 'webhook' and declines it ('webhookovi', 'webhookove'); the nominative singular is therefore identical to the English key.
